title: Task queue page: real count, clearer look, easy to find

chat.text: The queue page showed 0 tasks when about 133 are queued, it is hard to read, and you could not find a link to it. I am fixing all three: it will say "loading" until the real list arrives, show the top tasks as previews with detail one click away, and be linked from the sidebar, the session page and the day page.

It opens on one screen: the big count, then the top 8 tasks as cards you can click; the full list is one click down. It's linked from the day page, the session page and the AI rail.
